decided_by: Malcolm picked ingredient_1--B-material-macro-nbp_flash_02 for Copper Peptide and asked to see it live before the rest; then ingredient_3--B-material-macro-gpt_image_01 for Matrixyl 3000; then ingredient_1--F-cell-and-matrix-gpt_image_01 replacing the crystals, on the recommendation that the matrix is the mechanism
note:
Ingredient tiles for /pages/the-science. The section carries five `item` blocks, one per active, and all five are wearing placeholders: `ingredient_1` and `ingredient_3` are mega-menu thumbnails, `ingredient_4` and `ingredient_5` were lifted off the philosophy page.

This plan fills them one at a time as Malcolm picks. Copper Peptide first — the rest stay on their placeholders until chosen, which is why only one image is listed.

SOURCE: wave `science-ingredient-copper-peptide`, concept B (material macro), Nano Banana Flash candidate 02. Class B — no product in frame, so no product description or brand identity was supplied and nothing in the frame is branded.

NBP FLASH RETURNED 4096x4096 AGAINST A REQUESTED 2048. That is its documented behaviour — it ignores explicit pixel dimensions and snaps to its own nearest named ratio — so the file was resampled down to 2048 here rather than shipped at whatever the backend felt like. 2048 is the art direction's tile spec (§4) and the theme asks for 1400x1400; the tile itself renders at roughly 389px.

Ground colour is the clinical blue already agreed for Copper Peptide product photography, not a new one, so the tile belongs to the same world as the product shots.

MATRIXYL 3000 added 2026-08-25, same wave, same concept B, gpt-image candidate 01. Delivered at 2048 natively so no resampling was needed. It reads as a translucent cellular matrix on the teal ground already agreed for Matrixyl — which is the closest of the whole set to the cell-level register Malcolm asked for next.

COPPER PEPTIDE REPLACED 2026-08-25, crystals -> fibroblast in matrix. GHK-Cu's documented action is fibroblast activation: it prompts fibroblasts to synthesise collagen and remodel the extracellular matrix, which is what this page's own copy claims. Concept E is a portrait of the cell type; concept F shows the cell embedded in and merging with the matrix, which is the mechanism itself. F was chosen for that reason.

TWO F CANDIDATES WERE REJECTED ON SCIENTIFIC GROUNDS, not on looks. Both Seedream frames render a glowing cell body with many branching dendrite-like processes -- neurons, not fibroblasts. They are the most striking images in the batch, and nerve cells have nothing to do with GHK-Cu; on a page whose whole argument is peer-reviewed evidence, that would undercut the claim to any reader who recognised it.

SIZED 1400, NOT 2048. The theme's sizes attribute for this tile tops out at about 480 CSS px, so at 2x nothing above ~960 is ever requested; 1400 is the theme's own recommendation and sits above that ceiling. Quality 95, 4:4:4, metadata stripped, and deliberately NOT compressed harder -- Shopify's CDN re-encodes to WebP, so a pre-compressed source hands the encoder JPEG artefacts to reproduce, which was measured on this store to make pages marginally slower.

The crystals file stays in Shopify Files; the theme is simply repointed. A rename is always a new file here, since Files suffixes rather than replaces on a name collision.
